[[File:SmugglerOutpost2.jpg|250px|thumb|An aerial perspective of the Smuggler Outpost]]
The '''Smuggler Outpost''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] outpost on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] that was in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The outpost was mainly used as a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] visiting the planet.<ref name="SWG" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], numerous individuals visited or inhabited the Smuggler Outpost, including the [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Eyd Tommsin]],<ref name="SWG:ET">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Eyd Tommsin|Endor}}</ref> the smuggler [[Harding]],<ref name="SWG:SC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Smuggler|Smuggle Contraband|Endor}}</ref> the [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] [[Galody]] and [[Tupit]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> and [[the Ice Cream Man]] and his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Otonon Tracks]].<ref name="SWG:FonatF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Quest: "Find out more about the Fryer"}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Smuggler Outpost was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
